role: Knowledge fabric. Long-term knowledge synthesis. Receives weak signals from HALO, patterns from MNEMOS. Builds the durable knowledge layer that persists beyond individual sessions.
tick_behavior: Entropy 0.06-0.12. Slow accumulation. Knowledge synthesis is a background process — not per-tick but per-session boundary.
implementation_note: Currently materialized as memory/mnemos/domains/*.json files in the repo — versioned, always-readable knowledge base.
